description: This file contains unit test definitions for the CanvasA2 UI component of the OpenClawKit project. It uses the Testing framework to verify command string stability and JSONL message decoding and validation logic.

classes.name: CanvasA2UITests
classes.description: A test suite for CanvasA2 UI functionality in the OpenClawKit project.

methods.name: commandStringsAreStable
methods.description: Verifies that certain command string constants have expected raw string values.

methods.name: jsonlDecodesAndValidatesV0_8
methods.description: Tests decoding and validation of a JSONL string representing multiple messages consistent with version 0.8.

methods.name: jsonlRejectsV0_9CreateSurface
methods.description: Ensures that decoding a JSONL with a createSurface message (version 0.9) throws an error.

methods.name: jsonlRejectsUnknownShape
methods.description: Checks that an unknown message shape in JSONL throws an error during decoding.
